mock_data.title: Endangered Species
mock_data.passage:
Most of us are now aware of the damage which our modern way of life is doing to the environment. This includes the harm which we are inflicting on many animals. Indeed, we are in danger of wiping out some species, if we have not already done so.

For millions of years, extinction among animals was a natural process. In fact, it was part of the process of evolution. In recent years, however, the extinction of some species has been the result of human activities. Had it not been for these, many more animals would have survived.

Some species have either been made extinct, or become endangered, because of hunting. Now, even the very earliest of humans were hunters, since they ate the flesh of animals and clothed themselves in their skins, and doubtless their hunting gradually contributed to the extinction of some species. However, it was the introduction of guns, with their accurate aim, which put certain animals at great risk, and from the nineteenth century on several species were on the brink of extinction.

By this time, animals were being hunted for commercial purposes, apart from the provision of food and clothing. For example, elephants were being hunted for their ivory. Nowadays, attempts are being made to regulate such wholesale commercial hunting, but it is difficult to control in some areas. Thus, animals continue to die to make profits for humans. Of course, not only commerce is to blame. Hunting as a sport has also played a part in the extinction of certain species.

A more modern threat to many animals is the destruction of their environment and the resultant changes in the ecology of whole areas. Our use of pesticides and other chemicals has polluted both soil and water, and this pollution has proved to be toxic to many of the plants which are part of the habitat of many animals. Furthermore, we regularly lay waste to land previously inhabited by animals, in order to make way for expanding populations or, as in the case of deforestation, to provide goods for wealthy nations.

Modern living has had a deleterious effect on the ecosystem. We must try to reverse this to save our wildlife.
mock_data.passageB1:
We all know that our modern life is harming the environment. This also hurts many animals. Some animals may disappear completely because of what we do. We might have already made some animals disappear.

For millions of years, animals have died out naturally. This was part of how animals changed over time. But now, some animals are dying out because of things people do. If people had not done these things, many more animals would still be alive.

Some animals have become extinct, or are in danger of dying out, because people hunt them. People have always hunted animals for food and clothes. This probably made some animals die out slowly. But when guns were invented, it became much easier to kill animals. From the 1800s, some animals were very close to extinction.

At that time, people hunted animals to make money, not just for food and clothes. For example, elephants were hunted for their ivory. Now, people are trying to control this commercial hunting, but it is hard to do in some places. So, animals keep dying so that people can make money. Also, hunting for fun has helped make some animals die out.

A newer problem for many animals is that their habitat is being destroyed. This changes the ecology of whole areas. We use pesticides and other chemicals that pollute the soil and water. This pollution is poisonous to many plants that animals need to live. Also, we often destroy land where animals live to make room for more people or to get goods for rich countries, like cutting down forests (deforestation).

Modern life has had a bad effect on the environment. We need to change this to protect our animals and plants.
mock_data.passageB2:
It's now widely understood that our modern lifestyles are significantly damaging the environment. This includes the detrimental impact we're having on animal populations. In fact, we're jeopardizing the survival of numerous species, potentially pushing them to extinction.

For millennia, animal extinction was a natural part of evolution. However, in recent times, human activities have become a primary driver of species extinction. Without our interference, many more animals would likely have continued to thrive. Human actions have accelerated what would have been a natural process.

Hunting has either caused the extinction of some species or placed them on the endangered list. Early humans hunted for survival, using animal flesh for food and skins for clothing, undoubtedly contributing to the gradual disappearance of certain animals. However, the introduction of firearms, with their enhanced accuracy, posed a significant threat to specific species. From the nineteenth century onwards, several animals were on the verge of extinction due to hunting.

During this period, commercial hunting expanded beyond basic needs like food and clothing. For example, elephants were hunted extensively for their ivory. While attempts are now being made to regulate this large-scale commercial hunting, enforcement can be difficult in some regions. Consequently, animals continue to be killed for profit. However, commercial interests aren't solely responsible. Sport hunting has also played a role in the extinction of particular species.

A more contemporary threat to many animals is the destruction of habitat and the resulting disruption of entire ecosystems. Our use of pesticides and other chemicals has polluted both soil and water, proving toxic to many plants essential to animal habitats. Furthermore, we routinely clear land previously inhabited by animals to accommodate growing populations or, as with deforestation, to provide resources for wealthier countries. This is a pressing issue that needs addressing.

Modern living has had a destructive effect on the ecosystem. To preserve our wildlife, we must actively work to reverse this trend and find more sustainable ways of living. It's a shared responsibility.
mock_data.passageC1:
The pervasive environmental degradation wrought by our contemporary lifestyle is now, for the most part, axiomatic. This includes the undeniable harm inflicted upon countless animal species. Indeed, we are perilously close to eradicating certain species, if we haven't already sealed their fate.

For millennia, species extinction was an intrinsic element of the natural order, an inherent facet of evolutionary processes. However, the recent surge in extinctions is largely attributable to anthropogenic activities. It could be reasonably argued that, absent human intervention, a greater number of species would have persisted and even flourished.

Hunting has been instrumental in either driving species to extinction or rendering them endangered. While even early humans engaged in hunting for sustenance and clothing, thereby undoubtedly contributing incrementally to species decline, the advent of firearms, with their enhanced accuracy, precipitated a crisis for certain animals. From the nineteenth century onwards, several species found themselves teetering on the brink of oblivion.

By this juncture, the motivations behind hunting had expanded beyond mere survival, encompassing commercial exploitation. The hunting of elephants for ivory serves as a pertinent example. Whilst efforts are currently underway to regulate such large-scale commercial hunting, enforcement proves challenging in numerous regions. Consequently, animals continue to succumb to the pursuit of human profit. It is crucial to acknowledge that commercial interests are not solely to blame; recreational hunting has also played a role in the demise of specific species.

A more contemporary and insidious threat to wildlife stems from the destruction of their habitats and the consequent disruption of entire ecosystems. The extensive use of pesticides and other chemicals has contaminated both soil and water, engendering toxicity in plant life, which forms an integral part of many animals' natural environment. Furthermore, we routinely despoil land previously inhabited by animals to accommodate expanding human populations or, as exemplified by deforestation, to furnish resources for affluent nations. This reckless disregard for the natural world is tantamount to ecological vandalism.

Modern living has had a deleterious impact on the ecosystem, the repercussions of which are far-reaching. To safeguard our wildlife, we must endeavor to reverse this trend and foster a more sustainable coexistence with the natural world. The future hinges on our collective willingness to embrace change.

mock_data.translation:
Ko'pchiligimiz zamonaviy turmush tarzimiz atrof-muhitga yetkazayotgan zarardan xabardoriz. Bu ko'plab hayvonlarga yetkazilayotgan zararni o'z ichiga oladi. Haqiqatan ham, biz ba'zi turlarni yo'q qilish xavfi ostidamiz, agar buni allaqachon qilmagan bo'lsak.

Millionlab yillar davomida hayvonlar o'rtasida yo'q bo'lib ketish tabiiy jarayon edi. Aslida, bu evolyutsiya jarayonining bir qismi edi. Biroq, so'nggi yillarda ba'zi turlarning yo'q bo'lib ketishi inson faoliyati natijasi bo'ldi. Agar bu bo'lmaganida, ko'plab hayvonlar omon qolgan bo'lardi.

Ba'zi turlar ov qilish tufayli yo'q bo'lib ketgan yoki yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida qolgan. Endi, hatto eng qadimgi odamlar ham ovchilar edi, chunki ular hayvonlarning go'shtini yeyishdi va ularning terisiga o'rashdi va shubhasiz ularning ovi asta-sekin ba'zi turlarning yo'q bo'lib ketishiga hissa qo'shdi. Biroq, aniq nishonga olish imkoniyatiga ega qurollarning joriy etilishi ba'zi hayvonlarni katta xavf ostiga qo'ydi va o'n to'qqizinchi asrdan boshlab bir nechta turlar yo'q bo'lib ketish chekkasida bo'ldi.

Bu vaqtga kelib, hayvonlar oziq-ovqat va kiyim-kechak ta'minlashdan tashqari, tijorat maqsadlarida ovlanayotgan edi. Masalan, fillar fil suyagi uchun ovlanayotgan edi. Hozirda bunday ommaviy tijorat ovini tartibga solishga urinishlar qilinmoqda, ammo ba'zi hududlarda nazorat qilish qiyin. Shunday qilib, hayvonlar odamlar uchun foyda keltirish uchun o'lishda davom etmoqdalar. Albatta, faqat tijorat aybdor emas. Sport sifatida ov qilish ham ba'zi turlarning yo'q bo'lib ketishida o'z rolini o'ynadi.

Ko'plab hayvonlar uchun zamonaviyroq tahdid ularning yashash muhitining vayron bo'lishi va butun hududlarning ekologiyasidagi natijada yuzaga keladigan o'zgarishlardir. Pestitsidlar va boshqa kimyoviy moddalardan foydalanishimiz tuproq va suvni ifloslantirdi va bu ifloslanish ko'plab hayvonlarning yashash joyining bir qismi bo'lgan ko'plab o'simliklar uchun zaharli ekanligi isbotlandi. Bundan tashqari, biz muntazam ravishda avval hayvonlar yashaydigan yerlarni vayron qilamiz, bu kengayib borayotgan aholiga joy berish yoki boy mamlakatlar uchun tovarlar ishlab chiqarish uchun o'rmonlarni kesish holida qilinadi.

Zamonaviy hayot ekotizimga zararli ta'sir ko'rsatdi. Biz yovvoyi tabiatni saqlab qolish uchun buni o'zgartirishga harakat qilishimiz kerak.

mock_data.translationB1:
Hammamiz zamonaviy hayotimiz atrof-muhitga zarar yetkazayotganini bilamiz. Bu ko'plab hayvonlarga ham zarar yetkazadi. Ba'zi hayvonlar bizning xatti-harakatlarimiz tufayli butunlay yo'qolib ketishi mumkin. Ehtimol, biz allaqachon ba'zi hayvonlarning yo'qolishiga sabab bo'lgandirmiz.

Millionlab yillar davomida hayvonlar tabiiy ravishda qirilib ketgan. Bu hayvonlarning vaqt o'tishi bilan o'zgarishining bir qismi edi. Ammo hozir ba'zi hayvonlar odamlarning xatti-harakatlari tufayli qirilib ketmoqda. Agar odamlar bu ishlarni qilmaganida, ancha ko'p hayvonlar hali ham tirik bo'lar edi.

Ba'zi hayvonlar ovlanishi tufayli yo'q bo'lib ketdi yoki yo'q bo'lib ketish xavfi ostida. Odamlar doimo hayvonlarni oziq-ovqat va kiyim-kechak uchun ovlagan. Bu, ehtimol, ba'zi hayvonlarning asta-sekin qirilib ketishiga olib kelgan. Ammo qurollar ixtiro qilinganida, hayvonlarni o'ldirish ancha osonlashdi. 1800-yillardan boshlab ba'zi hayvonlar yo'q bo'lib ketish arafasida edi.

O'sha paytda odamlar hayvonlarni faqat oziq-ovqat va kiyim-kechak uchun emas, balki pul topish uchun ham ovlagan. Misol uchun, fillar fil suyagi uchun ovlangan. Hozirda odamlar bu tijorat ovini nazorat qilishga harakat qilmoqda, ammo ba'zi joylarda buni amalga oshirish qiyin. Shunday qilib, odamlar pul topishi uchun hayvonlar o'lishda davom etmoqda. Shuningdek, zavq uchun ov qilish ham ba'zi hayvonlarning yo'q bo'lib ketishiga yordam berdi.

Ko'pgina hayvonlar uchun yangi muammo ularning yashash joyining yo'q qilinishidir. Bu butun hududlarning ekologiyasini o'zgartiradi. Biz tuproq va suvni ifloslantiradigan pestitsidlar va boshqa kimyoviy moddalardan foydalanamiz. Bu ifloslanish hayvonlar yashashi uchun zarur bo'lgan ko'plab o'simliklar uchun zaharlidir. Shuningdek, biz ko'pincha ko'proq odamlar uchun joy ochish yoki boy mamlakatlar uchun tovarlar olish uchun hayvonlar yashaydigan yerlarni yo'q qilamiz, masalan, o'rmonlarni kesish (o'rmonlarning kesilishi).

Zamonaviy hayot atrof-muhitga yomon ta'sir ko'rsatdi. Biz hayvonlarimiz va o'simliklarimizni himoya qilish uchun buni o'zgartirishimiz kerak.
mock_data.translationB2:
Hozirgi zamon turmush tarzimiz atrof-muhitga jiddiy zarar yetkazayotgani keng tarqalgan tushunchadir. Bunga hayvonlar populyatsiyasiga ko'rsatayotgan salbiy ta'sirimiz ham kiradi. Aslida, biz ko'plab turlarning omon qolishini xavf ostiga qo'ymoqdamiz va ularni yo'q bo'lib ketishga olib kelishimiz mumkin.

Ming yillar davomida hayvonlarning yo'q bo'lib ketishi evolyutsiyaning tabiiy qismi bo'lgan. Biroq, so'nggi paytlarda inson faoliyati turlarning yo'q bo'lib ketishining asosiy omiliga aylandi. Bizning aralashuvimizsiz, ko'plab hayvonlar gullab-yashnashda davom etgan bo'lardi. Insonning harakatlari tabiiy jarayon bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan narsani tezlashtirdi.

Ov qilish ba'zi turlarning yo'q bo'lib ketishiga sabab bo'ldi yoki ularni yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida bo'lganlar ro'yxatiga kiritdi. Qadimgi odamlar omon qolish uchun ov qilishgan, hayvon go'shtidan oziq-ovqat uchun, terisidan esa kiyim-kechak uchun foydalangan, bu esa, shubhasiz, ayrim hayvonlarning asta-sekin yo'q bo'lib ketishiga hissa qo'shgan. Biroq, aniqligi yuqori bo'lgan o'qotar qurollarning paydo bo'lishi muayyan turlar uchun jiddiy tahdid soldi. XIX asrdan boshlab, bir qancha hayvonlar ov qilish tufayli yo'q bo'lib ketish arafasida edi.

Bu davrda tijorat ovchiligi oziq-ovqat va kiyim-kechak kabi asosiy ehtiyojlardan tashqariga chiqdi. Masalan, fillar suyaklari uchun keng ko'lamda ovlangan. Hozirda bu keng ko'lamli tijorat ovini tartibga solishga harakat qilinmoqda, ammo ba'zi hududlarda buni amalga oshirish qiyin bo'lishi mumkin. Natijada, hayvonlar foyda olish uchun o'ldirilishda davom etmoqda. Biroq, tijorat manfaatlari yagona javobgar emas. Sport ovchiligi ham muayyan turlarning yo'q bo'lib ketishida muhim rol o'ynadi.

Ko'plab hayvonlar uchun zamonaviy tahdid - bu yashash joylarining yo'q qilinishi va butun ekotizimlarning buzilishiga olib kelishi. Bizning pestitsidlar va boshqa kimyoviy moddalardan foydalanishimiz tuproq va suvni ifloslantirdi, bu esa hayvonlar yashash joylari uchun zarur bo'lgan ko'plab o'simliklar uchun zaharli ekanligini isbotladi. Bundan tashqari, biz doimiy ravishda o'sib borayotgan aholini joylashtirish uchun yoki o'rmonlarning kesilishi kabi boyroq mamlakatlar uchun resurslar ta'minlash uchun avval hayvonlar yashagan erlarni tozalaymiz. Bu hal qilinishi kerak bo'lgan dolzarb masala.

Zamonaviy turmush tarzi ekotizimga halokatli ta'sir ko'rsatdi. Yovvoyi tabiatimizni saqlab qolish uchun biz bu tendentsiyani o'zgartirish va yashashning yanada barqaror usullarini topish uchun faol ishlashimiz kerak. Bu umumiy mas'uliyatdir.

Bizning zamonaviy turmush tarzimiz natijasida yuzaga kelgan keng tarqalgan ekologik tanazzul, ko'p jihatdan, aksiomatik hisoblanadi. Bunga son-sanoqsiz hayvon turlariga yetkazilgan inkor etib bo'lmaydigan zarar ham kiradi. Haqiqatan ham, biz ayrim turlarni yo'q qilib yuborishga juda yaqinmiz, agar ularning taqdirini allaqachon muhrlab qo'ymagan bo'lsak.

Ming yillar davomida turlarning qirilib ketishi tabiiy tartibning ajralmas elementi, evolyutsion jarayonlarning o'ziga xos jihati edi. Biroq, so'nggi paytlarda qirilib ketish holatlarining keskin ortishi asosan antropogen faoliyat bilan bog'liq. Inson aralashuvi bo'lmagan taqdirda, ko'proq tur saqlanib qolishi va hatto rivojlanishi mumkin edi, deb taxmin qilish mumkin.

Ovchilik turlarni yo'q bo'lib ketishiga yoki yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida qolishiga olib keluvchi muhim omil bo'lib kelgan. Hatto qadimgi odamlar ham oziq-ovqat va kiyim-kechak uchun ov qilgan bo'lsalar, shu bilan turlarning kamayishiga asta-sekin hissa qo'shgan bo'lsalar ham, o'q otish qurollarining paydo bo'lishi, ularning aniqligi yuqori bo'lganligi sababli, ayrim hayvonlar uchun inqirozga olib keldi. XIX asrdan boshlab, bir nechta tur yo'q bo'lib ketish yoqasida qoldi.

Shu nuqtaga kelib, ovchilikning sabablari oddiygina omon qolishdan tashqari, tijorat maqsadlarida foydalanishni ham o'z ichiga oldi. Fil suyagi uchun fillarni ovlash bunga yaxshi misol bo'la oladi. Hozirda bunday keng ko'lamli tijorat ovini tartibga solish bo'yicha harakatlar olib borilayotgan bo'lsa-da, ko'plab hududlarda nazoratni ta'minlash qiyin bo'lmoqda. Natijada, hayvonlar inson foydasi uchun ta'qib qilishga qurbon bo'lishda davom etmoqda. Tijorat manfaatlari yagona aybdor emasligini tan olish muhim; dam olish uchun ov qilish ham muayyan turlarning yo'q bo'lib ketishida rol o'ynadi.

Yovvoyi tabiatga nisbatan zamonaviy va xavfliroq tahdid ularning yashash joylarining vayron qilinishi va butun ekotizimlarning buzilishidan kelib chiqadi. Pestitsidlar va boshqa kimyoviy moddalarning keng qo'llanilishi tuproq va suvni ifloslantirdi, bu ko'plab hayvonlarning tabiiy muhitining ajralmas qismi bo'lgan o'simliklar hayotida toksiklikni keltirib chiqardi. Bundan tashqari, biz odatda inson populyatsiyasining kengayishini ta'minlash uchun yoki, o'rmonlarning kesilishi misolida ko'rsatilganidek, badavlat davlatlar uchun resurslar yetkazib berish uchun ilgari hayvonlar yashagan erlarni buzamiz. Tabiiy dunyoga nisbatan bu beparvolik ekologik vandalizmga tengdir.

Zamonaviy hayot ekotizimga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatdi, buning oqibatlari uzoqqa boradi. Yovvoyi tabiatimizni himoya qilish uchun biz bu tendentsiyani o'zgartirishga va tabiiy dunyo bilan yanada barqaror hamkorlikni rivojlantirishga harakat qilishimiz kerak. Kelajak o'zgarishlarni qabul qilishga bo'lgan umumiy xohishimizga bog'liq.
